title: introduce-entropy-stabilized-synthetic-prober-and-failure-debouncer
author: Aisha Karim
body:
Motivation: A recurring pattern in our prompt-set regressions is short-lived entropy spikes from synthetic probes that trigger immediate CI escalations. This PR adds a new entropy-stabilized synthetic prober plus a failure-rate debouncer gate to reduce noise-driven flakiness while preserving sensitivity to true regressions.

Summary of changes: Added a pluggable synthetic prober that emits probe sets with controlled entropy perturbations across random seeds and context shuffles; introduced a debounced failure-rate metric and gate which requires sustained elevation for N windows before failing a CI job; wired the new signals into the smoke and regression gates and added telemetry (probe_entropy_score, debounced_failure_rate) to the eval console. The prober supports per-prompt-set policies and an opt-in config so teams can enable conservative probing for high-sensitivity prompts.

Design notes: The prober generates 4 probe modes: prefix-noise, suffix-noise, paraphrase-anchor, and context-swap. Each probe run collects multiple seeds (default 5) and computes an entropy-normalized agreement score. Entropy stabilization normalizes per-seed variance with a shrinkage estimator so rare-but-high-variance probes don't dominate the failure signal. The debouncer computes a rolling-window failure rate with exponential backoff and requires M consecutive windows over threshold to escalate (configurable; default windows=3, stride=1).

CI integration: The gate exposes two CI hooks: a pre-merge smoke hook (fast mode, 2 seeds, small sample) and a full regression hook (policy-controlled, backs off to soft-fail & ticket when triggered). Default behavior on hosted CI is soft-fail + create ENG ticket; on release branches it escalates after debouncer windows.

Testing and validation: Unit tests for entropy estimator, sampling scheduler, and debouncer logic added. End-to-end smoke tests included in ci/smoke/prober_smoke_test.py. We ran a 2-week canary across three teams (lexicon, search, docs) and observed reduced transient CI failures by ~68% with a 2.5% median increase in eval CPU time for full regression suites.

Migration and rollout: Feature-flagged behind eval.feature_flags.entropy_prober (off by default). Documentation added to docs/ci/probes.md with usage examples and opt-in guide. Operators can backfill historical probe metrics via the provided CLI command evalctl probe backfill --range.

Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] smoke tests [x] canary validation [x] docs update [x] telemetry dashboards [x] feature flag gating

Related: ENG-2189 (reduce transient regression noise), ENG-2204 (ci gate standardization).
